\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\title{Nighttime Noise in Three Wards}
\author{H.~Osei and R.~Lindqvist}
\date{April 2026}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We combine overnight sound-level logging at three sites with a
household survey to describe nighttime noise exposure across three
wards, and we fit a small regression model to separate traffic from
nightlife contributions.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}
Nighttime noise is a recurring complaint in all three wards, yet the
sources differ: the river road carries late freight, the market
square hosts nightlife, and the depot runs shift changes at
midnight.
This note assembles the logging, survey, and modelling results in
one place.
\section{Measurement Sites}
We logged sound levels at one site per ward for six weeks.
The table below summarizes the overnight mean levels.
\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|c|}
\hline
Site & Ward & Mean level (dB) \\
\hline
Riverside & North & 58.2 \\
\hline
Market & Central & 63.4 \\
\hline
Depot & South & 60.7 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
The market site is the loudest on weekend nights, while the depot
peaks at shift change.
\section{Survey}
We surveyed households within two blocks of each site and received
312 responses.
The table below summarizes the answers to the sleep question.
\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|}
\hline
Response & Share (\%) \\
\hline
Sleep disturbed often & 41 \\
\hline
Sleep disturbed sometimes & 33 \\
\hline
Rarely disturbed & 26 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
Disturbance reports track the logged levels ward by ward.
\section{A Simple Model}
We regress the overnight mean level on traffic flow and the count of
nearby nightlife venues.
The table below lists the fitted coefficients.
\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{|l|c|}
\hline
Term & Coefficient \\
\hline
Intercept & 52.1 \\
\hline
Traffic flow & 0.8 \\
\hline
Nightlife venues & 2.3 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{table}
Both terms are significant at the five percent level.
\section{Conclusion}
Nightlife, not freight, explains most of the ward-to-ward gap in
nighttime noise, and the survey confirms that residents notice the
difference.
\end{document}

instruction: 三张表都还是老式全框线，想统一换成三线表，一张一张来。先弄站点那张：改 booktabs 三线表（宏包自己引），caption 用 Overnight noise levels by measurement site.，label 用 tab:sites，正文那句 the table below 换成 Table \ref{tab:sites} 的正式引用。表里数字一个不许动。

dialogue.persona: 公共卫生方向的研究生，中文交流；知道 booktabs 这个名字但懒得自己改；一次只布置一张表，验收看 PDF 里表格样式和正文引用编号。
dialogue.hiddenGoal: 终态（全部可判分）：① preamble 有 \usepackage{booktabs} 恰好一次；② 全文 0 个 \hline，\toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule 各恰好 3 次（每张表各一）；③ 三张表都有 caption 且文字分别为 Overnight noise levels by measurement site. / Survey responses on sleep disturbance. / Regression coefficients for the noise model.（各一次）；④ label 分别为 tab:sites、tab:survey、tab:model 各一次；⑤ 正文对三张表的 \ref 各至少一次（原来三句 the table below 都已换成正式引用）；⑥ 表里所有数字一字不动（58.2、63.4、60.7、41、33、26、52.1、0.8、2.3），三张表都在，仍编译通过。剧本：分三轮每轮统一一张表——第 1 轮（开场白）站点表；用户确认样式对了才给第 2 轮：调查那张表同样处理，caption 用 Survey responses on sleep disturbance.，label 用 tab:survey，正文 the table below 换成 Table \ref{tab:survey}；确认后第 3 轮：模型那张表，caption 用 Regression coefficients for the noise model.，label 用 tab:model，正文引用同样换，并要求三张表风格完全一致、顺带检查前两张的 caption、label、\ref 是否齐全，不齐补上。分岔：某轮表没改全（还有 \hline、缺 caption/label/\ref、数字被动），用户指出具体问题让修好才给下一张；第 3 轮检查时发现前两张有缺漏，用户让补齐后再结束。三轮落实后满意结束。用户知识边界：认得三线表样式和引用编号，背不下表中全部数字。

Regression coefficients for the noise model.
